mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The signal is active without threshold conditions, as the rate level is continuously observed.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC of FEDFUNDS level on 20d SPX returns < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 9.5% signals a weak labor market, which typically leads to central bank policy accommodation and positive equity returns over the next 5 trading days. The signal activates when UNRATE crosses above 9.5%.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC of UNRATE threshold on 5d SPX returns < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) signals a contraction in the real economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days. The signal activates when both series fall below their 3-month moving averages.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC of HOUST-INDPRO interaction on 60d SPX returns < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising above 0.5% in the past 6 months), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced liquidity and higher risk-free rates.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC of FEDFUNDS tightening signal on 20d SPX returns < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong demand for residential construction, which is a leading indicator of economic expansion and positive equity returns over the next 60 trading days. The signal is continuously active as HOUST is observed.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC of HOUST level on 60d SPX returns < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A CPI index above 220 signals elevated inflation, which typically leads to central bank tightening and negative equity returns over the next 5 trading days. The signal activates when CPIAUCSL crosses above 220.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC of CPIAUCSL threshold on 5d SPX returns < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in employment (PAYEMS) and rise in unemployment (UNRATE) signals a deteriorating labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days. The signal activates when PAYEMS falls below its 3-month moving average and UNRATE rises above its 3-month moving average.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC of PAYEMS-UNRATE interaction on 60d SPX returns < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a housing market recovery (HOUST rising above 560 units), the S&P 500 experiences positive forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to increased consumer confidence and spending. The signal is active only in the context of a recovering housing market.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC of HOUST threshold on 20d SPX returns < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
